description: This source file defines a Java interface named MessageMapperExtension for wrapping or extending message mappers within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity framework. It declares a single method for instantiating or wrapping a MessageMapper, given specific context parameters.

classes.name: MessageMapperExtension
classes.description: A functional interface that facilitates wrapping or extending existing MessageMapper instances based on connection context, actor system, and other parameters.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates or wraps a MessageMapper instance for a given connection, mapper, and actor system; returns null if instantiation is not possible.
